helpSubtitle.message: Learn what the extension does and what each setting means

helpOverviewDesc.message: The extension processes links on every page automatically in this order: unwrap redirect links, remove same-origin target="_blank", and clean tracking parameters. It only modifies links, not page behavior.

helpGlobalIntro.message: These switches control the three main features globally.

helpTargetDesc.message: When enabled, links pointing to the same website (including relative URLs) will have target="_blank" removed and open in the current tab. Cross-site links are not affected.

helpRedirectToggleDesc.message: Global switch. When on, redirect links are replaced with the real destination according to the rules on the Redirects tab. When off, all redirect rules are ignored.

helpTrackingToggleDesc.message: Global switch. When on, tracking attributes and URL parameters are removed according to the rules on the Tracking tab. When off, all tracking rules are ignored.

helpRedirectIntro.message: Each rule matches redirect links on a given domain and extracts the real URL from a query parameter. Common sites like Juejin, Zhihu, Weibo are built in, and you can add custom rules.

helpRedirectFieldDomain.message: The domain to match (suffix match). For example, weibo.cn also matches www.weibo.cn.

helpRedirectFieldParam.message: The query parameter that carries the real URL, such as target or url. The value is decoded and assigned as the new link.

helpRedirectFieldPath.message: Optional. Only applies when the path matches this prefix, used when only certain paths are redirect pages (e.g. jianshu.com/go).

helpFieldEnabled.message: Temporarily disable the rule without deleting it.

helpFieldDesc.message: A note shown only for your reference.

helpTrackingIntro.message: Each rule matches a domain and performs three kinds of cleanup on its links. Common sites like Bilibili, Weibo, and Zhihu are built in.

helpTrackingFieldRemoveAttrs.message: HTML attributes to remove from the link element, such as data-spmid or suda-uatrack.

helpTrackingFieldPrevent.message: Block the page from rewriting the link on click, forcing direct navigation instead of a tracked redirect.

helpTrackingFieldParams.message: Query parameters to remove from the link URL, such as utm_source or spm_id_from. Enter * to remove all parameters. Keep functional parameters like p and t out of this list.

helpWhitelistDesc.message: Websites on the whitelist are skipped entirely. Matching uses domain suffixes: adding example.com also covers www.example.com and sub.example.com. You can also add or remove the current site from the popup.

helpBackupExport.message: Export downloads the current configuration (diff from built-in rules) as a JSON file for migration or backup.

helpBackupImport.message: Import restores a previously exported JSON file and overwrites all current custom settings.

helpBackupReset.message: Reset clears all custom rules, overrides, and whitelist changes and restores factory defaults.

helpStorageNoteDesc.message: Config is stored as a diff against built-in rules, so new or corrected built-in rules automatically take effect after the extension updates unless you modified or removed them.

globalTrackingParamsDesc.message: Common tracking parameters removed from links on all websites. Stacks with per-domain rules. Keep functional parameters (e.g. Bilibili p, t) out of this list.
